text:
Mina Alvarez: Quick thread on policy-eval ordering & tie-breaks. We've had nondeterministic route picks when costs and latency scores are within noise.
Omar Khan: Yep. Two problems: (1) unstable ordering because scores are floats with tiny diffs, (2) model-variant affinity where we prefer lower-cost variant but it has subtle quality regressions.
Zoe Park: Proposal: deterministic comparator: primary = availability (up), secondary = SLA tier match, tertiary = rounded cost score (to 1e-3), quaternary = latency percentile penalty, final = stable route_id hash. That removes flakiness.
Daniel Brooks: Agreed on rounding. Also add a per-tenant override called `prefer_quality` that biases comparator by delta_quality_score (signed). Default 0.
Mina Alvarez: How do we measure delta_quality_score? We have evals per model-variant, but noisy. Suggest we use smoothed rolling mean over last N eval runs and expose confidence intervals. Use lower bound for comparator so we only bias when confident.
Omar Khan: For tie-break telemetry, emit `route.select_debug` event with fields: {candidates, scores_rounded, chosen, tie_breaker}. Keep small payloads.
Zoe Park: For model-variant affinity: ability to pin customer->variant but still allow fallback. Proposal: `affinity_mode: [soft, hard]`. Soft means prefer variant A but fall back to others per comparator; hard means only variant A unless unavailable.
Daniel Brooks: Ops concern: rolling upgrades may change quality. If a variant is pinned hard, we need an alert when its quality drops below threshold. Add alert rule: if pinned_variant_quality < baseline - X for 15m -> page.
Mina Alvarez: Cost windows: we already have cost caps per-tenant. Need to tie routing to cost window consumption: when tenant spends > P% of budget, comparator should demote expensive candidates. Implement as dynamic penalty added to cost score: penalty = alpha * max(0, spend_pct - P). alpha configurable per-tenant.
Omar Khan: Edge case: two tenants share a pool; penalties must be tenant-scoped and applied after availability check. Also ensure penalty calculation runs in O(1) per request (no heavy DB lookups). Use cached token-bucket snapshot from control plane.
Zoe Park: Add a developer flag `--deterministic-route-eval` for local testing to force deterministic comparator and emit `route.select_debug` to stdout.
Daniel Brooks: For auditability, store last 5 selection decisions per route_id in a compact ring buffer and surface via `GET /v1/routes/{id}/selection-history`. Include only reason codes and candidate hashes to keep size bounded.
InfraBot: Note: will add metric `routing.tie_break_rate` and histogram of `score_diffs_rounded` to help tune rounding precision.
PolicyBot: sample comparator pseudo-config:
```
comparator:
  order:
    - availability
    - sla_match
    - cost_rounded_precision: 0.001
    - latency_p95_penalty
    - tenant_cost_penalty_alpha: 0.5
    - variant_affinity_soft_preference: true
  stability: route_id_hash
```
Mina Alvarez: Action items: Zoe to PR comparator implementation + flag. Omar to wire cached spend snapshot. Daniel to add selection-history endpoint and alert. I'll draft docs and tie-break telemetry spec. Revisit in 48h. :thumbsup:
